<script>
    (function () {
        const componentId = "c2_wcarousel_1--gtm";
        const wrapper = document.getElementById(componentId);
        const sliderEl = document.getElementById(componentId + "_slider");
        const playPauseBtn = document.getElementById(componentId + "_playPauseBtn");
        const pauseSrc = "https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt964243cdd7810dea/bltbb12959797e4cc5a/68dbe6f05b98db396064ec16/button_pause_default.svg";

        function formatStandardCountdown(distance) {
            const days = Math.floor(distance / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            const hours = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
            const minutes = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
            const seconds = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
            const mm = minutes < 10 ? "0" + minutes : minutes;
            const ss = seconds < 10 ? "0" + seconds : seconds;
            let output = "";

            if (days >= 1) output += days + "d ";
            if (hours > 0) output += hours + "h ";
            if (minutes > 0) output += mm + "m ";
            if (hours === 0 && seconds > 0) output += ss + "s ";

            return output.trim();
        }

        function updateCountdowns(root) {
            const now = Date.now();
            (root || document).querySelectorAll(".c2-countdown[data-countdown-end]").forEach(function (el) {
                const endTime = new Date(el.dataset.countdownEnd).getTime();
                if (Number.isNaN(endTime)) return;

                const distance = endTime - now;
                if (distance <= 0) {
                    el.textContent = el.dataset.countdownExpired || "00h";
                    return;
                }

                el.textContent = formatStandardCountdown(distance);
            });

            if (!sliderEl || !playPauseBtn || !window.bootstrap || !window.bootstrap.Carousel) return;

                interval: 5000,
                pause: false,
                ride: false
            });

            function setPlayPauseIcon(paused) {
                const icon = playPauseBtn.querySelector(".c2-play-pause-icon");
                const action = paused ? "Play" : "Pause";
                const label = action + " carousel and video";

            function shouldPlayVideo(video) {

            function syncCarouselState() {
                if (componentInView && !isPaused && !focusInSlides) bsCarousel.cycle();

            function findBarFor(overlay) {

                    sibling = sibling.previousElementSibling;

                return null;

            function syncBarOffsets() {
                sliderEl.querySelectorAll(".text-overlay-top-left").forEach(function (overlay) {

                    if (!bar) return;

            syncVideos();
            syncBarOffsets();

                syncVideos();

            sliderEl.addEventListener("slide.bs.carousel", function () {
                sliderEl.querySelectorAll("video").forEach(function (video) {
                    video.pause();
                });
                scheduleBarOffsetSync();
            });

            sliderEl.addEventListener("slid.bs.carousel", function () {
                syncVideos();
                scheduleBarOffsetSync();
            });

            window.addEventListener("resize", scheduleBarOffsetSync);

            // Keep the slide put while a keyboard user is on its link or buttons.
            const slidesInner = sliderEl.querySelector(".carousel-inner");
            if (slidesInner) {

                    syncCarouselState();

                updateCountdowns(sliderEl);
            }, 1000);
        }

        // so autoplay and dots skip them.
        function initSlideTargeting() {
            if (!sliderEl) return;
            const inner = sliderEl.querySelector(".carousel-inner");
            const indicators = sliderEl.querySelector(".c2-indicators");
            if (!inner || !indicators) return;
            const allSlides = Array.prototype.slice.call(inner.querySelectorAll(".carousel-item"));
            const allDots = Array.prototype.slice.call(indicators.querySelectorAll("[data-bs-slide-to]"));
            const isTargeted = function (el) {
                return (

                    el.hasAttribute("data-target-store") ||
                    el.classList.contains("gmc-hide")

            };
            if (!allSlides.some(isTargeted)) return;

            const pool = document.createElement("div");
            pool.hidden = true;
            pool.className = "c2-slide-pool";
            sliderEl.appendChild(pool);

            // Moves only misplaced items: re-inserting a <video> pauses it.
            function place(items, container) {
                let previous = null;
                items.forEach(function (item) {
                    if (item.hidden) {
                        if (item.parentNode !== pool) pool.appendChild(item);
                        return;
                    }
                    const expected = previous ? previous.nextElementSibling : container.firstElementChild;
                    if (item !== expected) container.insertBefore(item, expected);
                    previous = item;
                });
            }

            function applySlideTargeting() {
                const activeBefore = inner.querySelector(".carousel-item.active");
                allSlides.forEach(function (slide) {
                    if (slide.hidden && slide.parentNode === inner) {
                        slide.querySelectorAll("video").forEach(function (video) {
                            video.pause();
                        });
                    }
                });
                place(allSlides, inner);
                place(allDots, indicators);

                const slides = Array.prototype.slice.call(inner.querySelectorAll(".carousel-item"));
                let activeIndex = slides.indexOf(activeBefore);
                if (activeIndex < 0) activeIndex = 0;
                allSlides.forEach(function (slide) {
                    slide.classList.toggle("active", slide === slides[activeIndex]);
                });

                const dots = Array.prototype.slice.call(indicators.querySelectorAll("[data-bs-slide-to]"));
                dots.forEach(function (dot, index) {
                    dot.setAttribute("data-bs-slide-to", String(index));
                    dot.setAttribute("aria-label", "Slide " + (index + 1));
                    dot.classList.toggle("active", index === activeIndex);
                    if (index === activeIndex) dot.setAttribute("aria-current", "true");
                    else dot.removeAttribute("aria-current");
                });
                allDots.forEach(function (dot) {
                    if (dot.parentNode === pool) {
                        dot.classList.remove("active");
                        dot.removeAttribute("aria-current");
                    }
                });

                indicators.style.display = slides.length <= 1 ? "none" : "";
            }

            applySlideTargeting();
            if (wrapper) wrapper.addEventListener("hp-targeting-change", applySlideTargeting);
        }

        initSlideTargeting();

        function ensureBootstrapBundle() {
            if (window.bootstrap && window.bootstrap.Carousel) return Promise.resolve();
            if (!window.__homepageBootstrapBundlePromise) {
                window.__homepageBootstrapBundlePromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    const existing = document.querySelector('script[data-homepage-bootstrap-bundle="true"]');
                    if (existing) {
                        existing.addEventListener("load", resolve, { once: true });
                        existing.addEventListener("error", reject, { once: true });
                        return;
                    }
                    const script = document.createElement("script");
                    script.src = bootstrapBundleSrc;
                    script.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
                    script.dataset.homepageBootstrapBundle = "true";
                    script.onload = resolve;
                    script.onerror = reject;
                    document.head.appendChild(script);
                });
            }
            return window.__homepageBootstrapBundlePromise;
        }

        ensureBootstrapBundle().then(initCarousel).catch(function () { });
    })();
</script>
